bootstrap.method: Fixed50 equal-weight tasks; independently resample10 source IDs with replacement within each task; reuse same source draws for all16cells and26paired comparisons. Task/source ordering is identical to prior H10/H30 analyses.
bootstrap.CI: Pointwise percentile2.5/97.5%; not multiplicity-adjusted. No additional hypothesis tests.
bootstrap.limits: Conditional on fixed50tasks and empirical10sources/task; not task-population or training-seed uncertainty. Degenerate all0/all1 task strata contribute zero empirical within-task variance.

training_coverage_description.basis: Pre-existing5task training coverage supplied by parent; descriptive strata only, no intervals/tests or model/task selection.

cost_interpretation: Policy-call all-episode means and success-only conditional means use different denominators and are reported separately. Success-only subsets differ by method/H and are not paired equal-work cohorts.
Realized total calls/steps depend on success and termination times; fewer calls do not establish an intrinsic per-intervention cost reduction or total inference speedup.
Main inference_seconds records generation/correction only. Context/D/G0 time belongs to elapsed_seconds; do not read inference_seconds as total policy-stack time.

elapsed_seconds is saved host episode wall duration. Sum across overlapping jobs is worker-time accounting, not concurrent makespan or GPU time; do not subtract fields to infer net correction or D/G0 cost.
Worker model loads/job environment setup are not included unless explicitly represented by the per-episode field. No new timing audit was performed.
Absent fields remain null, including N explicit sampling_calls/interventions and unavailable time-scope labels. Saved policy_calls is retained under its own name.
Cross-H comparisons are descriptive, not equivalence/noninferiority claims. No optimization or follow-up experiment is implied.
